args.text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.

Hi Dana, I went through all six of Moss's digests in the shared files and found two Quarrendon Freight Lines (QFL) ticket numbers:

• *#PD-4492*: from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md). Thea Ramaswell opened it on 4 Oct 2025 because the Eau Claire gatehouse kiosk wasn't sending SMS bay assignments for Dock Doors 14–18. Support patched it on 4 Oct, and Thea confirmed it was fixed on 5 Oct. The same digest also says to make sure the kiosk logs are archived before the 14 Oct maintenance window.
• *#4419*: from "Moss: North cheat sheet (undated)" (teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md). Thea logged it because the gatehouse barcode scanners weren't reading trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift. The cheat sheet says it was escalated to tier-2 for firmware testing.

A few notes:
• Moss's 9/14 North pipeline digest and 3/23/2026 renewal check-in both mention QFL, but neither one has a ticket number.
• Tickets #4409 and #4412 in Moss's Central handoffs digest are for a Central dealer account, not QFL.
• Marcus's "Quarendon Freightways" intel note is about a different company (not a customer), so I didn't include it.
• The cheat sheet has no date, so I can't tell whether #4419 came before or after #PD-4492. They might also use different numbering schemes. Worth checking before you put both in the weekly notes.

I've sent Dana the list in her DM. I read all six of Moss's digests in the shared files, which are all public. Two of them have Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers:

- **#PD-4492** is in "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (2025-10-05). It was about the gatehouse kiosk at the Eau Claire yard not sending text-message bay assignments for Dock Doors 14–18. Support fixed it on 4 Oct, and Thea Ramaswell confirmed the fix on 5 Oct.
- **#4419** is in "Moss: North cheat sheet," which has no date. It was about barcode scanners at Door 14 not reading trailer tags. It was passed to tier-2 support for firmware testing.

I also told her what I left out and why:
- Moss's 9/14 pipeline digest and 3/23 renewal note mention QFL but don't give any ticket numbers.
- Tickets #4409 and #4412 in Moss's Central handoffs digest belong to a different account.
- Marcus's "Quarendon Freightways" note is about another company, which isn't a customer.

Because the cheat sheet has no date, I suggested Dana check #4419 before putting it in the weekly notes. Its number also doesn't have the PD- prefix, so the two tickets may come from different systems.

I didn't read any channels or use message search, so this list only covers Moss's files.
